meaning:
1) to be ashamed, be confounded, be abashed, feel abashed
1a) (Qal) to be ashamed, be abashed
1b) (Hiphil) to display shame, demonstrate shame, cause embarrassment

renderings.kjv: for they are brought unto shame
let them be put to shame
for thou shalt not be put to shame

elsewhere.note: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.
They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.
A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.
She who has borne seven languishes. She has given up the spirit. Her sun has gone down while it was yet day. She has been disappointed and confounded. I will…
The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer from God.”
